task: Deepen flagship 7 (photo-editing): check lensfun vignetting against compiled liblensfun 0.3.4
errors: First full run used 227k cases (crop x aspect x focal-midpoint grid) and a per-pixel Python opcode loop; killed and cut to 97k cases with a vectorised gain and a one-in-ten sample for the pure-Python fit (~7 min).
First result showed a 100% 'port' gap: fisheye calibrations where c <= 0 (lensfun clamps to black) and near-singular c (gain >100) where float32 rounding decides; split out and reported separately.
First post description was 241 characters; venture-preflight's front-matter check caught it (limit 160).
goal: Run the vignetting port against compiled lensfun, as the distortion port was, and say how close it is.
notes: tools/lensfun_vignetting_released_check.py on lensfunpy 1.18.0 (liblensfun 0.3.4): 97,382 cases on 474 lenses, 800 px frames. Port gap median 0.00012%, p99 0.0034%, max 0.32% (float32, 93x corner gain). Release vs master pixel unit: corner gain p99 0.12% at 6000 px, max 10% (46% at 800 px). Shipped FixVignetteRadial vs release p99 1.2% at 800 px. 133 near-singular cases, all refused by build_vignette. Tests: 6 new (tests/test_lensfun_vignetting_released.py), four seeded faults caught; run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok (97 s).
